summary: Tested Illaka selector feature end-to-end (backend + frontend). 20 backend tests all pass. Found and fixed 1 critical bug in IllakaContext.jsx: sessionStorage cleared on page reload due to auth loading race condition. All 15 feature requirements verified.

issues: Multiple TEST_Illaka_Central entries appear in selector (leftover test data from previous iterations) - not a code bug, just test data pollution

bugs_fixed.issue: sessionStorage (bk_illaka_sel) was being cleared on every page reload. Root cause: IllakaContext's useEffect ran with user=null during auth loading phase (before /auth/me responded), immediately removing sessionStorage item. Then when auth completed, sessionStorage was already gone so illaka selection was lost.
bugs_fixed.fix: Added `const { user, loading } = useAuth()` (was only `user`) and added `if (loading) return;` guard at top of useEffect. Added `loading` to dependency array: `[user?.id, loading]`.
bugs_fixed.rca: Race condition between AuthContext (async /auth/me check) and IllakaContext's sessionStorage cleanup. During initial render, user=null triggers `sessionStorage.removeItem()` before auth resolves. Fix: skip effect entirely while auth is loading.

rca_of_issue.bug: Illaka selection (sessionStorage bk_illaka_sel) lost on every page refresh
rca_of_issue.root_cause: IllakaContext.jsx useEffect depends on [user?.id]. On page load: 1) user=null → effect runs → `!user` is true → sessionStorage.removeItem() called. 2) AuthContext resolves /auth/me → user set → effect runs again → reads from sessionStorage → but it was already cleared in step 1.
rca_of_issue.reproduction: 1. Login, select an Illaka, verify switcher shows it. 2. Refresh page. 3. Illaka selector appears again instead of Dashboard.
rca_of_issue.fix: In IllakaContext.jsx: add `loading` from useAuth(). At top of useEffect, add `if (loading) return;`. Add `loading` to dependency array. This ensures sessionStorage is only modified after auth state is fully resolved.
rca_of_issue.lines_changed: Line 11: `const { user } = useAuth()` → `const { user, loading } = useAuth()`. Line 16-17: added `if (loading) return;` guard. Line 47: `[user?.id]` → `[user?.id, loading]`.
